title: "W10_task2"
format: html

```{r}
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
scripture <- read.csv("https://github.com/beandog/lds-scriptures/raw/master/csv/lds-scriptures.csv")
```

```{r}
NT <- scripture %>%
mutate(word_count = str_count(scripture_text, " ") + 1) %>% 
  filter(volume_id == 2)
View(NT)

BM <- scripture %>%
mutate(word_count = str_count(scripture_text, " ") + 1) %>% 
  filter(volume_id == 3)
View(BM)
```

```{r}
mean(NT$word_count)
mean(BM$word_count)
```


```{r}
J_NT <- NT %>% 
  mutate(jesus = str_count(scripture_text, "\\bJesus\\b")) %>% 
  mutate(book_title = factor(book_title, levels = rev(unique(book_title))))

J_BM <- BM %>% 
  mutate(jesus = str_count(scripture_text, "\\bJesus\\b")) %>% 
  mutate(book_title = factor(book_title, levels = rev(unique(book_title))))

sum(J_NT$jesus)
sum(J_BM$jesus)
```

```{r}
ggplot(J_BM, aes(x = book_title, y = word_count)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
ggplot(J_BM, aes(x = book_title)) +
  geom_bar() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw()
```
